claims.statement: Without a valid account payment method, usage is blocked when quota is exhausted. With one, spending may be limited by one or more budgets, whose appropriateness needs review; payment presence is not an unlimited-spend grant or proof that a stop budget exists. The linked budget article remains separately unreviewed evidence.

The usage-view navigation selects Usage in the sidebar and, for enterprises, Metered usage. A UI entry is not an observed usage amount, complete billing record or authority to inspect financial accounts.

The pinned text states Enterprise Cloud trials created on or after August 1, 2024 already enroll in usage-based billing. Invoiced volume, subscription or prepaid enterprise-license agreements retain that billing until expiry, with an option at renewal to switch to metered billing. An option is not automatic migration or evidence of the user's agreement.

Personal accounts created after February 13, 2025 may have a billing experience different from the parent article, with plan and detail management in the new platform. The creation-date caveat is preserved; the linked parent is not inherited review or a current-account observation.

The fragment asserts new billing-platform availability to all users at the pinned snapshot. It supplies no per-feature, permission or account eligibility detail and is not live availability verification.

The enterprise billing menu step selects Billing and licensing at the top of the page using a decorative icon. It is contextual navigation, not a verified entitlement, financial inspection or performed mutation.
The isolated Create your enterprise click lacks identity, plan, agreement and cost prerequisites. It is a contextual creation step, not approval to create an enterprise or a creation receipt.

The source permits assigning an enterprise team to a cost center and describes all members being added, with membership automatically following joins and departures rather than per-user maintenance. Dynamic attribution may change as team membership changes; this is not approval, live synchronization proof, a charge measurement or an audit of the linked team article.
